functions.name: DateSerial
functions.signature: DateSerial(Year As Integer, Month As Integer, Day As Integer) As Variant
functions.description: Returns a Variant (Date) for a specified year, month, and day.

parameters.name: Year
parameters.description: Required; Integer. Number between 100 and 9999, inclusive, or a numeric expression.

functions.name: Day
functions.description: Returns a Variant (Integer) specifying a whole number between 1 and 31, inclusive, representing the day of the month.

functions.name: Hour
functions.description: Returns a Variant (Integer) specifying a whole number between 0 and 23, inclusive, representing the hour of the day.

functions.name: Minute
functions.description: Returns a Variant (Integer) specifying a whole number between 0 and 59, inclusive, representing the minute of the hour.

functions.name: Month
functions.description: Returns a Variant (Integer) specifying a whole number between 1 and 12, inclusive, representing the month of the year.

functions.name: Now
functions.description: Returns a Variant (Date) specifying the current date and time according to your computer's system date and time.

functions.name: Second
functions.description: Returns a Variant (Integer) specifying a whole number between 0 and 59, inclusive, representing the second of the minute.

functions.name: Timer
functions.description: Returns a Single representing the number of seconds elapsed since midnight.

functions.name: TimeSerial
functions.signature: TimeSerial(Hour As Integer, Minute As Integer, Second As Integer) As Variant
functions.description: Returns a Variant (Date) containing the time for a specific hour, minute, and second.

parameters.name: Hour
parameters.description: Required; Variant (Integer). Number between 0 (12:00 A.M.) and 23 (11:00 P.M.), inclusive, or a numeric expression.

functions.name: TimeValue
functions.description: Returns a Variant (Date) containing the time.

functions.name: Weekday
functions.signature: Weekday(Date As Variant, [FirstDayOfWeek As VbDayOfWeek]) As Variant
functions.description: Returns a Variant (Integer) containing a whole number representing the day of the week.

parameters.name: Date
parameters.description: Required. Variant, numeric expression, string expression, or any combination, that can represent a date. If _date_ contains Null, Null is returned.

parameters.name: FirstDayOfWeek
parameters.description: Optional. A constant that specifies the first day of the week. If not specified, vbSunday is assumed.

functions.name: Year
functions.description: Returns a Variant (Integer) containing a whole number representing the year.

functions.name: DateAdd
functions.signature: DateAdd(Interval As String, Number As Double, Date As Variant) As Variant
functions.description: Returns a Variant (Date) containing a date to which a specified time interval has been added.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: Required. String expression that is the interval of time you want to add.

parameters.name: Number
parameters.description: Required. Numeric expression that is the number of intervals you want to add. It can be positive (to get dates in the future) or negative (to get dates in the past).

parameters.name: Date
parameters.description: Required. Variant (Date) or literal representing the date to which the interval is added.

functions.name: DateDiff
functions.signature: DateDiff(Interval As String, Date1 As Variant, Date2 As Variant, [FirstDayOfWeek As VbDayOfWeek], [FirstWeekOfYear As VbFirstWeekOfYear]) As Variant
functions.description: Returns a Variant (Long) specifying the number of time intervals between two specified dates.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: Required. String expression that is the interval of time you use to calculate the difference between _date1_ and _date2_.

parameters.name: FirstDayOfWeek
parameters.description: Optional. A constant that specifies the first day of the week. If not specified, Sunday is assumed.

parameters.name: FirstWeekOfYear
parameters.description: Optional. A constant that specifies the first week of the year. If not specified, the first week is assumed to be the week in which January 1 occurs.

functions.name: DatePart
functions.signature: DatePart(Interval As String, Date As Variant, [FirstDayOfWeek As VbDayOfWeek], [FirstWeekOfYear As VbFirstWeekOfYear]) As Variant
